audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides said 'Skill' on rows 1, 2, 4-5 and first item while content win[] and the packet both say Sylas levels 1 through first item, Kassadin at 2+ items. phases[6].why also described Sylas winning under a Kassadin side.
audit.why: Kassadin is a scaling champion with no early answer to Sylas poke; he flips it with Rod/Seraph's and stacked Riftwalk (2s cd maxed).
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Sylas; phases[6].why rewritten to match the Kassadin verdict.

audit.why: Spikes: Sylas 3-5 all-ins when his Q shield is down, 6 catches him even through Riftwalk, first item closes; Kassadin flips at 2+ items with Rod/Seraph's and R stacks. Content spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were pasted trade strings; the Nether Blade auto-reset burst tell (missing-interactions) appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s; his Q Null Sphere (9s rank 1) shields magic damage and interrupts channels; W Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset whose wind-up telegraphs the combo.
audit.corrected: Numbers added; bleed bodies rewritten, one now carries the auto-reset tell.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Once Rod or Seraph's finishes and R stacks, his 2-second Riftwalk hunts you — group and end before then.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Abscond (shield-dash) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, 2s maxed — you never out-wait it; commit when he burns stacks or mana. - His Q shield is 9s at rank 1: bait it with Chain Lash, then all-in. - Budget E Abscond for emergencies.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His Nether Blade wind-up telegraphs the burst — E2-chain him as he steps in and the combo fizzles into your whirls.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: His Q flies first in every trade — E-shield as he casts, not after Force Pulse lands, or the trade is his math.

notes: Chart: content win[] and packet already agreed (Sylas rows 1-6, Kassadin 2+ items); moved the four full-layer 'Skill' sides to Sylas — win[] already matched, so side-only per the chart rule, and those rows' whys already described Sylas winning. phases[6] side was already Kassadin but its why described Sylas late-game; rewritten. Kassadin Q flags 'channel: interruptible' — Riot's text says his Q INTERRUPTS channels, it is not itself a channel; wrote nothing based on that flag. Also note his Q shield absorbs MAGIC damage specifically, which blunts Sylas's whole kit — reflected in the cooldowns advice to bait it first. Missing-interaction (Nether Blade auto-reset tell) folded into dosFull[1].d.
